description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across model layers, using a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis, labeled “Layer,” spans from 0 to approximately 22 with linear spacing and integer tick labels. The y-axis, labeled “Sparsity Ratio,” ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 with linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line representing “sparsity ratio before gate,” which remains near zero across all layers (starting at ~0.02 and decreasing to ~0.005); an orange dotted line for “sparsity ratio after gate,” which begins at ~0.82 at layer 0, drops sharply to ~0.15 by layer 5, then gradually declines to ~0.02 by layer 22; and a green dash-dot line for “sparsity ratio after average gate,” which starts at ~0.78, falls steeply to ~0.10 by layer 5, and continues declining to ~0.01 by layer 22. The legend also reports average sparsity ratios over all layers: 0.003 for before gate, 0.126 for after gate, and 0.080 for after average gate.
